name: Browse
description: Open a URL in this workspace's browser (a real Chromium the user can watch and take over) and read it: for logins, forms and pages that need scripts; for a plain public page, web-scraping is quicker. One tab per chat; logins and cookies last between chats. Returns the interactive elements with refs ([e12]) for browser-act, then the visible text, and the first time a Card line. Public websites only.
